description:
Appodeal is a dynamic US-based product company with a truly global presence.

 We have offices in Warsaw, Barcelona and Parkland (FL), along with remote team members located around the world.

 Our company thrives on diversity, collaboration, and innovation, making us a leader in the mobile app monetization space.

 Why Appodeal? 

 At Appodeal, we’re more than just a company—we’re a team united by a common mission: Help people discover and grow their talents through products that enable successful mobile app businesses! 

 We take pride in our cutting-edge product and our internationally dispersed team of talented professionals.

 Here’s what we value, and what we hope you do too:

 
 Seek the Truth and Say It with Care: We find the truth together, and nobody owns it, the CEO included. Stories, perspectives and beliefs can be personal. Facts can’t.

 Leverage Data to Build Product: Our decisions start from data. We build systems rather than one-off tasks, use AI agents in our daily work and automate whatever is manual. When numbers don’t match, we fix them.

 We Work Together to Serve Others: No closed doors between teams. We share what we learn and win as one company first.

 Insist on Higher Standards: We don’t settle for “good enough”. We question it and push for better.

 Passionate Curiosity Fuels Perseverance: We ask “why”, take on ambiguous problems and keep going when they get hard.

 Lean Startup Mentality: Start Small, Iterate Quickly: Think big, ship an MVP first and learn fast. No big-bang releases.

 Ownership and Accountability: We work in small squads so each team owns its result end to end and has the freedom to get there. Go deep in your craft and wide enough to own the whole outcome. Escalate blockers early, admit mistakes, fix the damage and learn.

 
 Appodeal is looking for a Junior Software Engineer to build internal tools, automations and AI-powered solutions that will scale our business and transform the way our teams work.

 
 Location:  Parkland, FL (Hybrid — 3 days in office, 2 days remote)

 
 About the Role 

 This is a rare opportunity  to work directly with the  CEO of a technical startup that operates at a global scale  and build a career in  AI, digital advertising, human potential, and mobile gaming .
As a  Junior Software Engineer , you’ll help build internal tools and cutting-edge automations that improve the way our company works — from meeting analytics to AI-driven feedback, OKR tracking, and custom integrations. You’ll work hands-on with the CEO to bring bold ideas to life, experiment with the latest AI technologies, and create solutions that scale across a global organization.
This role is ideal for someone  hungry to learn, coachable, and curious , who wants to be at the intersection of  AI innovation and business impact . We care about how you think, learn and solve problems — not about which stack you’ve used before. What You’ll Do 

 
 Partner directly with the CEO to  design, build, and implement AI-powered automations  across the company.

 Write code to build internal tools, integrations and automations — choosing the language and tools that fit the task.

 Implement projects such as:
 
 Tracking and reporting  non-L10 meetings .

 Delivering  personalized automated feedback  to team members.

 Integrating  Garmin and other wearables  with ChatGPT/Claude.

 Automating  log transfers  (e.g., Limitless to Google Drive).

 Connecting  OKRs to AI systems  for real-time tracking and accountability.

 


 Use AI/LLMs to analyze data, documents and processes, and turn findings into clear recommendations.

 Prepare  executive summaries  for the CEO with insights and outcomes.

 Document processes, ensure adoption, and train teams.

 Work  independently with minimal follow-up , driving projects from concept to execution.

 
 What We’re Looking For 

 
 Experience automating processes or routine tasks — with code, scripts, or any tools you’re comfortable with.

 Basic coding skills (Python, JavaScript or another programming language).

 Comfort working with  APIs, REST, and webhooks .

 Full stack software development experience.

 Experience with AI-assisted analysis: using LLMs to process data, summarize information and extract insights.

 Comfortable using AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, coding assistants) in everyday work.

 Fast learner — able to pick up a new language, framework or tool when the task requires it.

 0–2 years of engineering experience; recent graduates and career switchers are welcome.

 Analytical problem-solving skills.

 Coachable  — open to feedback, adapts quickly.

 Strong communication skills, including preparing clear  executive-level summaries .

 Ability to follow company  OKR frameworks and standards .

 Self-driven with a  bias for action .

 
 Mindset & Traits 

 
 Passionate about  AI, automation, and emerging technologies .

 Curious and independent learner  who thrives with little oversight.

 Entrepreneurial and fast-moving — comfortable iterating and learning quickly.

 Strong sense of  ownership and accountability .

 
 Core Values You’ll Live By 

 
 Seek the Truth and Say It with Care 
We find the truth together, and nobody owns it, the CEO included. Stories, perspectives and beliefs can be personal. Facts can’t.

 Leverage Data to Build Product 
Our decisions start from data. We build systems rather than one-off tasks, use AI agents in our daily work and automate whatever is manual. When numbers don’t match, we fix them.

 We Work Together to Serve Others 
No closed doors between teams. We share what we learn and win as one company first.

 Insist on Higher Standards 
We don’t settle for “good enough”. We question it and push for better.

 Passionate Curiosity Fuels Perseverance 
We ask “why”, take on ambiguous problems and keep going when they get hard.

 Lean Startup Mentality: Start Small, Iterate Quickly 
Think big, ship an MVP first and learn fast. No big-bang releases.

 Ownership and Accountability 
We work in small squads so each team owns its result end to end and has the freedom to get there. Go deep in your craft and wide enough to own the whole outcome. Escalate blockers early, admit mistakes, fix the damage and learn.

 
 Work Schedule 

 
 5 days a week 
 
 3 days in-office  (Parkland, FL)

 2 days remote 

 


 
 Growth Path 

 
 Career growth into Software Engineer → Senior Engineer , AI Engineer , or AI Product Manager .

 Direct mentorship from the CEO, with exposure to  AI, digital advertising, mobile gaming, and human potential  at a global scale.

 
 If you’re hungry, curious, and ready to build the future of AI-driven work, this is your opportunity! 
 With an outstanding product and a mission that excites and inspires, Appodeal offers a unique opportunity to make an impact while being part of an amazing team.

 Join us and help shape the future of mobile app success!
